scheme_name: Prize Schemes to the Students (State Level Prizes)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a student
The beneficiary must be a resident of Tamil Nadu
The beneficiary must belong to Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC) or Denotified Communities (DNC)
The beneficiary must be studying in a Government, Government‑Aided or Private school
The beneficiary must have studied Tamil as the first language
If more than one student secures the same marks, awards are granted to all such students
benefits_summary: Cash prizes ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 for top‑ranked students, with amounts differing for boys and girls.
documents_required: Application form collected from the educational institution
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
